title: YouTube title, thumbnail, description and captions

video_id.label: YouTube video id (uploaded, not yet public)

face.label: Real photo of your face for the thumbnail

steps.title: Find outlier videos
steps.prompt: Search YouTube for videos in this niche: {{inputs.niche}}. Find 10 outliers, videos with far more views than their channel's usual. Write {{run.dir}}/outliers.md: each title, views, channel median, and the title and thumbnail pattern it uses.

steps.title: Write ten titles
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/words.json and the patterns in {{run.dir}}/outliers.md, write 10 titles under 60 characters that the video delivers on. Write {{run.dir}}/titles.json as a list of items with id, title, reason (the pattern it uses) and status pending. Set the output key items to that path.

steps.title: Approve thumbnail generation
steps.gate_summary: Approve sending {{inputs.face}} to the image generation service to make four thumbnail concepts for the titles in {{run.dir}}/titles.json.

steps.title: Make four thumbnail concepts
steps.prompt: Make four different thumbnail concepts at 1280 by 720 with the image generation service, each using the real face in {{inputs.face}} and at most four words of text, following the patterns in {{run.dir}}/outliers.md. Save {{run.dir}}/thumbs/thumb-0.png to thumb-3.png. Set spent_usd to what it cost.

steps.title: Check them at 160 px
steps.prompt: Shrink each image in {{run.dir}}/thumbs/ to 160 px wide and look at it. Is the text readable, the face clear, the idea obvious? Write {{run.dir}}/legible.md with pass or the problem per thumbnail. Set passed to true when at least two pass.

steps.title: Pick the title and thumbnails
steps.gate_summary: Approve one title in {{run.dir}}/titles.json and drop the rest. Write the two thumbnail file names you want to A/B test into {{run.dir}}/pick.md (see {{run.dir}}/legible.md), then Continue.

steps.title: Write description and captions
steps.prompt: From {{run.dir}}/words.json write {{run.dir}}/description.md: two plain lines on what the video gives, then chapters with timestamps at the scene changes. Write {{run.dir}}/captions.srt from the word times.

steps.title: Approve the update
steps.gate_summary: Approve to set the approved title in {{run.dir}}/titles.json, the two thumbnails in {{run.dir}}/pick.md as an A/B test, {{run.dir}}/description.md and {{run.dir}}/captions.srt on video {{inputs.video_id}}.

steps.title: Update the video
steps.prompt: On YouTube video {{inputs.video_id}}, set the title whose status is approved in {{run.dir}}/titles.json, start a thumbnail A/B test with the two files named in {{run.dir}}/pick.md, set the description from {{run.dir}}/description.md and upload {{run.dir}}/captions.srt. Change nothing else, including visibility. Set url to the video link.
